---
title: "9 Set Up the Sequencing Run with MinKNOW"
---

**Approximate time:** < 1 hour for setup

- [ ] Ensure stable power and network access as required.
- [ ] Start MinKNOW.
- [ ] Run the Flow Cell Health Check.
- [ ] Record the number of available pores and apply the workshop acceptance criterion.
- [ ] Start a new sequencing experiment and select the correct Flongle flow cell.
- [ ] Select the actual ligation sequencing kit used in the workshop.
- [ ] Select the basecalling model / accuracy mode specified by the workshop lead.
- [ ] Confirm output path, basecalling and read-filter settings.
- [ ] Start sequencing.
- [ ] Monitor active pores, data yield and read quality.
- [ ] Record any change from the planned settings.

::: {.callout-note}
The original WAMBAnet handout used Ligation Sequencing Kit V14 and recommended SUP basecalling. The SHARK-Seq site records these as reference choices; the actual MinKNOW version and kit available at the workshop take precedence.
:::
